opportunities.observation: The pinned small-M down GEMM has 84 hidden-width CTAs and materializes BF16 [M,5376] before a row reduction.
opportunities.evidence_scope: SGLang v0.5.13, Gemma 4 31B, TP=1, M in {1,16,32}, H200 sm_90a
opportunities.resource_signature: 84 producer CTAs (0.636 H200 waves), one FP32 partial per row/CTA, one row finalizer CTA
competing_explanations: The partials save finalizer arithmetic but add traffic and epilogue instructions.
A different partial tree may fail pinned RMSNorm rounding parity.
opportunities.mechanism: Cast each down output to BF16, persist it, and emit aligned 64-leaf FP32 sum-of-squares partials for a bounded finalizer.
opportunities.modifiable_fraction: Only the post-down materialization/normalization/quantization boundary; both GEMMs remain.
opportunities.upper_bound: At most all measured post-FF residual, one next-layer input RMSNorm, and QKV dynamic-quant producer time.
opportunities.falsifier: Dominated if the same legal finalizer preserves the control tree without partial traffic, or if partial-tree bytes/rounding erase the bound.
opportunities.next_measurement: CPU tree parity and exact byte accounting.

opportunities.observation: SM90a DSM can synchronize at most a bounded CTA cluster while the row spans 84 64-column output tiles.
opportunities.evidence_scope: SGLang v0.5.13 small-M swapped-AB CUTLASS dispatch, H200 sm_90a
opportunities.resource_signature: At least 11 eight-CTA clusters per row-width group; no portable cross-cluster barrier or DSM address space
competing_explanations: A cooperative-grid kernel could add a device-wide barrier but changes launch/graph constraints.
Serializing all strips in one cluster avoids the barrier but sacrifices producer parallelism.
opportunities.mechanism: Use an eight-CTA cluster to retain hidden strips and reduce row statistics in DSM.
opportunities.modifiable_fraction: Cluster-local strips only; exact two-stage row normalization still needs global coordination.
opportunities.upper_bound: Cannot remove the BF16 down materialization without cross-cluster retention or producer serialization.
opportunities.falsifier: Reject if 5376 columns exceed one legal cluster's simultaneous ownership and every repair is dominated by the materialized or two-phase control.

opportunities.observation: After the down result is materialized, all remaining dependencies are row-local and two BF16 rows plus deterministic reduction scratch fit comfortably in one H200 CTA.
opportunities.evidence_scope: Pinned dense Gemma4 layer transition, TP=1, M in {1,16,32}
opportunities.phase: post-down finalization and next QKV activation production
opportunities.resource_signature: One 256-thread CTA per row, about 43 KiB shared memory, 1/16/32-CTA finalizer grids
competing_explanations: The three stock row kernels may already be launch-latency dominated enough that one larger finalizer wins.
Extra barriers and shared-memory traffic may offset some launch/DRAM savings.
opportunities.mechanism: Keep the stock down GEMM, then perform post-FF RMSNorm, residual/scalar, next RMSNorm, and E4M3 production in one row-owned finalizer while persisting only the residual and quantized QKV input.
opportunities.modifiable_fraction: Removes two launches and eight hidden-width bytes per element from the materialized boundary.
opportunities.upper_bound: All measured post-FF residual plus one next-input RMSNorm plus QKV dynamic-quant producer time; actual gain must be measured.
opportunities.falsifier: Reject if complete reference bytes differ, shared memory exceeds H200 legality, compulsory bytes do not fall, or target-H200 paired component timing is non-positive.
opportunities.next_measurement: CPU/reference complete-byte oracle, then exact-consumer H200 A/B if admitted.

opportunities.observation: The pinned runtime materializes down BF16, layer output BF16, and next-normalized BF16 across three post-down producer launches.
opportunities.evidence_scope: Pinned SGLang v0.5.13 exact c32 stack
opportunities.resource_signature: Down GEMM plus three row kernels plus QKV GEMM
competing_explanations: Cache residency can make byte conservation overstate HBM savings.
opportunities.falsifier: Any candidate must beat its exact bytes/launches without changing complete reference output.
opportunities.next_measurement: Use as oracle and later H200 timing control.
